landing.seo.title: pqp: group chat with voice and screen sharing
landing.seo.description: Voice, text, and screen sharing for your people, straight from the browser. Make a community, send the link. Open source, free, and the server can be yours.
landing.hero.title: Come hang out at pqp.
landing.hero.body: Voice, chat and screen sharing for your people. Make a community, share the link. That's it.
landing.hero.hint: Have an invite link? Open it. Already have an account? Sign in.
landing.pitch.title: Tired of renting the room?
landing.pitch.body: Big chat apps rewrite the house rules, bury your communities, and treat your crew like inventory. pqp is the opposite: make a community, invite people, talk. Keep the keys if you want, or use ours and skip the ops.
landing.how.title: Three moves. Then you're loud.
landing.how.body: No onboarding maze. Create, invite, cause problems.
landing.how.step1.title: Make a community
landing.how.step1.body: Name it something stupid. Text and voice channels show up ready.
landing.how.step2.title: Drop an invite
landing.how.step2.body: Share a code. Friends pile in, no app-store gatekeeping.
landing.how.step3.title: Talk
landing.how.step3.body: Spam the channels. Jump into mesh voice when the group chat isn't enough.
landing.features.title: The basics, done right.
landing.features.body: No roadmap promises. Everything here works today, in the browser, on the desktop, or installed on your phone.
landing.features.voice.title: Voice channels
landing.features.voice.body: Jump in and talk. Audio goes straight between you, up to about 5 or 6 people per channel.
landing.features.screen.title: Screen sharing
landing.features.screen.body: Show the game, the code or the bug to everyone in the channel. One person at a time.
landing.features.chat.title: Chat with no fuss
landing.features.chat.body: Markdown, replies, reactions, pinned messages and @mentions. Paste a link and it unfurls.
landing.features.search.title: Find what was said
landing.features.search.body: Search a whole community by word and land on the message, with what came before and after.
landing.features.dms.title: DMs and group chats
landing.features.dms.body: Message someone privately, or put up to 10 people in the same group.
landing.features.structure.title: Your community, your rules
landing.features.structure.body: Categories to keep it tidy, private channels, and three roles: owner, admin, member.
landing.features.invites.title: An invite is just a link
landing.features.invites.body: Send it and they're in. Cap how many times it works and how long it lasts.
landing.features.moderation.title: Moderation that holds
landing.features.moderation.body: Kick, ban, delete and take reports from inside the app, all of it logged.
landing.features.tela.lead: Here because Discord's screen share stopped?
landing.features.tela.link: See what works today for sharing a screen in the browser
landing.hosting.title: Run it yourself, or don't
landing.hosting.body: Same product. You pick who babysits the metal.
landing.hosting.selfHost.title: Self-host
landing.hosting.selfHost.body: Clone the repo, point it at Postgres, plug in your own Clerk keys. Your data stays on your box. Unlimited for OSS use, you own the stack.
landing.hosting.hosted.title: Hosted at pqp.gg
landing.hosting.hosted.body: Sign up and go. We run the servers, auth, and storage. Same chaos, zero ops.
landing.cta.title: The room's empty. Fix that.
landing.cta.body: Spin up a community in under a minute. Invite the chaos later.
landing.cta.beta: On iPhone? Grab a spot in the iOS beta.
landing.cta.android: On Android? Get the APK beta.
landing.communities.title: Rooms you can just walk into
landing.communities.body: Not everything starts with an invite. The directory is full of rooms about one stupid thing each. Pick one, tap join, you're in. Or make yours and let people find it.
landing.communities.point1.title: No invite, no queue
landing.communities.point1.body: One tap and you're inside. Nobody has to approve you first.
landing.communities.point2.title: Sorted the way people talk
landing.communities.point2.body: Games, music, football, humour. Ten categories, no taxonomy lecture.
landing.communities.point3.title: Yours stays yours
landing.communities.point3.body: List it when you want to be found, unlist it when you don't. You still run the room.

vsDiscord.seo.title: A Discord alternative in 2026: an honest comparison | pqp
vsDiscord.seo.description: Voice, text, and screen sharing work on pqp, in the browser. Discord suspended screen share and video in Brazil on 17 Aug 2026. A line-by-line comparison, free.
vsDiscord.hero.body: Discord is excellent, we are not going to pretend otherwise. Since 17 August 2026, Go Live, video, and screen share have been suspended in Brazil by ANPD order, with no return date. Communities that lived on watch parties, study-with-screen, and RPG tables lost the main tool. pqp is open source, free, and in open beta. Here is the scoreboard, including where Discord still wins.
vsDiscord.hero.disclaimer: Product claim, not legal advice: Discord has said screen share, video, and Go Live are suspended in Brazil since 17 Aug 2026 under an ANPD order, with no return date in their letter.
vsDiscord.featured.pqpDetail: Screen share, and camera in calls, right from the browser, today.

vsDiscord.closing.body: If your community needs shared screens and you want something free and open, try pqp today, takes a minute, no card. If you need a mature ecosystem with bots and polished store apps, Discord is still unbeatable, when video comes back.

vsDiscord.faq.title: Quick questions
vsDiscord.faq.why.q: Why is Discord screen share suspended in Brazil?
vsDiscord.faq.why.a: Discord announced that screen share, video, and Go Live are suspended for users in Brazil since 17 August 2026, complying with a preventive order from the ANPD, Brazil's data-protection authority. That is Discord's own announcement, this page is a product comparison, not legal advice.
vsDiscord.faq.when.q: When does Discord screen share come back in Brazil?
vsDiscord.faq.when.a: No date has been announced. Discord's letter to its Brazilian community says they are working to restore the features, without saying when.
vsDiscord.faq.how.q: How can my group share a screen today?
vsDiscord.faq.how.a: Create a community on pqp.gg, send the invite link, and share your screen straight from the browser, the game, the code, the slides. Free, nothing to install; there's a desktop app too.
vsDiscord.faq.catch.q: Is pqp really free? What's the catch?
vsDiscord.faq.catch.a: Free and open source. Use the hosted service at pqp.gg, or run your own copy on your own machines, the code is public. It's an open beta: young, honest about it, and built in the open.

tela.seo.title: A Discord alternative for sharing your screen | pqp
tela.seo.description: Share your screen with friends without Discord, straight from the browser, with audio. An honest comparison of what works today in Brazil. Free and open source.
tela.hero.title: Discord without screen share in Brazil? You can still share your screen today, in the browser.
tela.hero.lede: Since 17 August 2026, Discord's screen share, video and Go Live are suspended in Brazil under an ANPD order; voice and text keep working. This page is about what you can use right now. Keep the Discord server if you like, and share the screen somewhere else.
tela.hero.disclosure: Full disclosure: pqp is our product. The other options below are listed because they solve the same problem, and one of them may fit you better.
tela.options.title: What works today
tela.option.pqp.name: pqp.gg
tela.option.pqp.body: Voice, text, screen share and camera, in the browser, nothing to download. Free, open source, servers in São Paulo. Open beta, built by two brothers.
tela.option.pqp.good: A small group of friends that wants a room that stays: channels, voice and a screen, with the link shared once.
tela.option.pqp.limit: Peer-to-peer voice holds up well to about 5 or 6 people per room; past that, quality drops. Bigger rooms are being tested. It is a beta: expect rough edges.
tela.option.jitsi.name: Jitsi Meet
tela.option.jitsi.body: Video calls in the browser with screen share, no account needed. Free and open source.
tela.option.jitsi.good: A one-off call: open a link, share the screen, done.
tela.option.jitsi.limit: It is a meeting, not a community chat: no channels, no history, and the room is empty when everybody leaves.
tela.option.teamspeak.name: TeamSpeak 6
tela.option.teamspeak.body: Voice servers with screen share inside a server. Desktop app.
tela.option.teamspeak.good: Groups that already run a TeamSpeak server and want a screen in it.
tela.option.teamspeak.limit: Needs the app and a server; 1-to-1 calls with screen share are still in alpha.
tela.option.meet.name: Google Meet
tela.option.meet.body: Screen share works, in the browser, with a Google account.
tela.option.meet.good: A quick call with people who all have a Google account already.
tela.option.meet.limit: The free plan has a time limit on group calls, and it is a meeting, not a place your group lives in.
tela.options.asOf: Status as of 21 August 2026, from each company's own public notes. If something changed, tell us: contato@pqp.gg.
tela.how.title: How to do it on pqp in one minute
tela.how.1: Create a room: sign up (free, no card) and create a community. You get a voice channel right away.
tela.how.2: Send the invite link to your people. Nobody downloads anything; it opens in the browser.
tela.how.3: Everybody joins the voice channel and whoever wants to shares the screen, or the camera. That is it.
tela.faq.title: Quick questions
tela.faq.download.q: Do I need to download anything?
tela.faq.download.a: No. pqp runs in the browser on desktop and on Android. There is a desktop app if you want one, and an iOS beta via TestFlight, but neither is required.
tela.faq.vpn.a: No. This is not a way around anything: pqp is a different app with its own servers in Brazil, and screen share is a feature it has. Nothing here touches Discord.
tela.faq.people.q: How many people can share a screen in one room?
tela.faq.people.a: Two people can share a screen at the same time, side by side, and each one has its own fullscreen button. The room itself works well with 5 or 6 people on voice, which is peer-to-peer. Bigger rooms are being tested and are not the default yet.
tela.faq.free.a: Yes. pqp is open source under the AGPL (github.com/rafaelcg/pqp). Use the hosted service at pqp.gg for free, or run your own copy.
tela.faq.mobile.q: Does it work on a phone?
tela.faq.mobile.a: On Android there is an APK beta at pqp.gg/android. On iPhone, TestFlight at pqp.gg/beta. The browser still works on both. Neither is on the stores yet.
tela.faq.data.q: What do you keep about me?
tela.faq.data.a: Less than you would expect, and all of it is listed in plain language in the privacy policy at pqp.gg/privacy. Hosted pqp.gg uses cookie-less analytics (Umami) and a Google Ads conversion tag that only counts sign-ups. No remarketing, no audience lists.
tela.cta.title: Want to try it now?
tela.cta.body: A room takes a minute to make and the link is all your friends need.

apoie.seo.title: Support the project · pqp
apoie.seo.description: pqp is free, open source, and built by two brothers. The hosted service costs about US$50 a month. A contribution is a gift toward hosting: nothing is unlocked, nothing changes, and the product stays free for everyone.
apoie.title: Help keep pqp online
apoie.body.1: pqp is built by two brothers, me, Rafael, and my brother, and it's still in beta. The hosted service at pqp.gg costs on the order of US$50 a month in infrastructure: the API server in São Paulo, the database, the relays that carry voice across networks, the storage. The rest is our time, and that part is gladly given.
apoie.body.2: A contribution is a gift toward the hosting bill. It unlocks nothing: no perks, no tiers, no badge, and no refunds. pqp stays free, stays open source, and every feature keeps shipping to whoever runs their own copy. If you just want to help it stay online, this is how.
apoie.sponsors.title: GitHub Sponsors

apoie.pix.title: Pix
apoie.pix.body: If you're in Brazil, Pix is the simplest way. Copy the key below, or the copy-and-paste code, into your bank's app. Any amount.
apoie.closing: pqp is open source under the AGPL. The code, the issues and what comes next are all public.

connection.doctor.advice.apiUnreachable: The pqp server cannot be reached at all. Check the internet connection, a VPN or a firewall, and try mobile data to compare. If other sites work, a DNS filter may be blocking pqp.gg.
connection.doctor.advice.tokenStuck: Your sign-in never answers. Something on this device or network is blocking the sign-in service (an ad blocker, a DNS filter, or a VPN). Pause it for pqp.gg, or try another network.
connection.doctor.advice.signInAgain: The server no longer accepts this session. Sign out and sign in again; that renews it on every device.
connection.doctor.advice.socketBlocked: Web pages load but the live connection is blocked. Some office and school networks and some VPNs do this. Try mobile data or another network.
connection.doctor.advice.relayBlocked: Chat works, but this network gives calls no way through. Try another network, or a VPN if you are on a corporate one.
connection.doctor.advice.noUdp: This network blocks the traffic calls need. Chat works, voice will not. Try mobile data or another network.
status.invisibleHint: You'll show as offline to everyone, and you won't appear in channel or typing indicators. Voice channels you join still show you, people can hear you there.
status.dndHint: You stay visible; this device stops popping notifications.
status.saveFailed: Could not change your status, try again
ageGate.title: Confirm your date of birth
ageGate.description: pqp is for people aged {age} and over.
ageGate.intro: We ask once, and we do not check it against any document, we are taking your word for it. Please make it accurate before you continue, because you cannot change this answer later.
ageGate.warning: You can only answer this once. If the date you enter is under {age}, this account will be closed and you will not be able to try a different date.
ageGate.error.badDate: That is not a date we can read. Check the day, month and year.
ageGate.error.save: Could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
ageGate.blocked.title: pqp is for {age} and over
ageGate.blocked.body: Thanks for answering honestly. The date of birth you gave is under {age}, so this account is closed. That is a rule about the service, not a judgement about you, pqp is built for adults and we are not able to make exceptions to it.
ageGate.blocked.appeal.before: If you entered the wrong date by mistake, you can ask us to look at it again. The address for appeals, and for asking us to delete the account and the data attached to it, is on our
ageGate.blocked.wait: Please do not open another account in the meantime, we would rather settle this one.
onboarding.handle.title: Now the paperwork
onboarding.handle.description: One field. This is the name people type to find you, we took it off your account, and the number is yours.
onboarding.handle.label: Handle
onboarding.handle.hint: Lowercase, numbers and _ only. The number after it comes free.
onboarding.handle.reassigned: Somebody already had that one. You got {tag}.
onboarding.handle.error.taken: That name is full, every number behind it is taken. Pick another one.
onboarding.handle.error.invalid: Lowercase, numbers and _ only, between 2 and 32 characters.
onboarding.profile.title: Now the part people see
onboarding.profile.description: The handle is how they find you. This is how they see you.
onboarding.landing.title: Nobody's here yet
onboarding.landing.description: Make a community and send the link, or paste one somebody sent you.
onboarding.landing.createHint: Text and voice channels show up ready. Invite people whenever.
onboarding.landing.joinError: That invite doesn't work. Ask for another.
firstRun.title: Three things and this place works
firstRun.server.title: Get into a community
firstRun.server.body: Make one for your people, or paste an invite you were sent.
firstRun.friend.title: Find your people
firstRun.friend.body: Add someone by their handle. Yours is {tag}, hand it out.
firstRun.avatar.title: Put a face on it
firstRun.avatar.body: A letter in a box works. A photo works better.
arrival.title: You're in {server}
arrival.body: Say oi in #{channel}. That's the whole trick, nobody knows you're here until you say something.
arrival.bodyNoChannel: Pick a channel on the left and say something. Nobody knows you're here until you do.
invite.create.description: Anyone with the link can join until it expires or you revoke it.
invite.create.notAllowed: Only owners and admins can make invites.
invite.create.none: No invites yet. Make one to share this community.
invite.create.copyFailed: Clipboard is blocked, select the link and copy it by hand.
invite.join.title: Invite code
invite.join.description: Paste an invite link, or type the code you were given.
invite.join.label: Invite code
invite.join.failed: That invite doesn't work. Ask for another.
voice.meshWarning: Mesh limit approaching, configure an SFU for larger calls.
voice.idle.body: Join voice to talk. Chat stays available beside you.
voice.alone: You're the only one here so far.
voice.control.shareUnavailable: Share your screen (unavailable on this device)
voice.control.shareLimit: This call already has {limit} screen shares
voice.control.shareSound: Send this computer's sound with the share
voice.control.shareSoundDetail: Off by default. Turned on, everything this machine plays goes out, the call's own voices included, so people hear themselves back.
voice.ptt.hintButton: Hold the button above to talk.
voice.ptt.unfocused: This window isn't focused, the key won't reach it. Click here first, or use the button.
voice.share.noAudio: Sharing without sound. To send the audio too, share a Chrome tab and tick the share-tab-audio box.
voice.share.tickAudio: Pick a Chrome tab and tick “Also share tab audio” to send the sound too.
voice.share.systemAudioOn: The whole computer's sound goes out, call voices included, so everyone hears themselves back. A Chrome tab sends only its own sound.
voice.share.systemAudioOff: Computer sound off. A Chrome tab still sends its own sound.
voice.share.systemAudioLive: You are sending this computer's sound. Everyone in the call hears themselves back.
voice.screenShareUnsupported: Screen sharing isn't supported by this browser.
voice.screenShareInsecure: Screen sharing needs a secure (HTTPS) connection.
voice.error.shareLimit: This call already has the maximum number of screen shares ({limit}).
voice.error.cameraLimit: This call already has the maximum number of cameras ({limit}).
voice.error.micBlocked: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, then rejoin.
voice.error.micMissing: No microphone found. Plug in a microphone or headset and try again.
voice.error.joinTimeout: The call did not connect in time. The live connection to pqp may be down for you; run the connection check to see why.
voice.error.micUnreadable: Your microphone could not be started. Another app may be using it, or it needs unplugging and plugging back in. Pick a different microphone in voice settings and try again.
voice.error.micUnreadable_desktop: Your microphone could not be started. Another app may be using it, or it needs unplugging and plugging back in. Pick a different microphone in voice settings and try again.
voice.notice.micFallback: Your usual microphone would not start, so this call is using {label}.
voice.notice.micFallbackUnnamed: Your usual microphone would not start, so this call is using another one.
voice.error.shareBlocked: Screen share was blocked or cancelled.
voice.error.shareAudioUnavailable: That screen's audio could not be opened, so nothing was shared. Only a Chrome tab has audio to give: pick "Chrome Tab", tick "Also share tab audio" and try again. A window never has sound, and a whole screen only does on Windows.
voice.error.shareAudioUnavailable_deskto: That screen's sound could not be opened, so nothing was shared. In the app only a whole screen on Windows can carry sound. Share without sound, or open pqp in Chrome and share a tab if the sound matters.
voice.error.shareNeedsAppUpdate: Update the pqp desktop app to share your screen.
voice.error.noVideoTrack: No video track from screen capture
voice.error.transportUnsupported: This call runs on a voice server this app build cannot use, so you have not joined it. Nobody in the call can hear you.
voice.error.transportUnreachable: Could not reach the voice server, so you have not joined this call. Check your network and try again.
voice.error.cameraBlocked: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
call.incoming.title: Incoming call
call.quality.unmeasured: No outgoing video to measure on this call yet.
call.quality.receiving.measuring: Video from {name} is arriving. Measuring it.
call.quality.receiving.none: Nobody is sending you video right now.
call.quality.receiving.sendersChoice: The sender picks that size. Nothing on this side can raise it, so ask them to send more if it is too soft.
channel.meta.image.error.httpsOnly: Image links need to start with https://.
channel.meta.image.error.invalid: That doesn't look like a URL.
friends.title: Friends
friends.addFriend.hint: Handles are exact, ask for the name#0000 and type it here.
friends.addFriend.label: Add a friend by handle
friends.empty.all.title: No friends here yet
friends.empty.all.body: Add someone by their handle and they'll show up here, with a dot that says whether they're around.
friends.empty.pending: No pending requests. Quiet is fine.
friends.loadFailed: Couldn't load your friends, try again.
friends.remove.confirm.title: Remove {name} from your friends?
friends.remove.confirm.body: They won't be told. Either of you can ask again later.
friends.nudge.request: Someone sent you a friend request.
profile.cancelRequest.confirm: Take back your request to {name}? They won't be told either way.
profile.removeFriend.confirm: Remove {name} from your friends? They won't be told.
profile.block.confirm: Block {name}? This ends the friendship and hides their messages.
profile.mod.timeout.title: Time out {name}
profile.mod.timeout.body: They can still read. They can't post, react or join voice in this community until it ends.
profile.mod.kick.title: Remove {name} from this community?
profile.mod.kick.body: They lose access now but can rejoin with any invite.
profile.mod.ban.title: Ban {name} from this community?
profile.mod.ban.body: They lose access and can't rejoin. The reason is kept on the ban list.
cargosHint.title: Roles are on the profile now
cargosHint.body: Open someone and tick one: Admin, Manager, Mod, or VIP. Homemade cargos sit next to those.
qgHint.title: Come into the QG
qgHint.body: Announcements, help, and the place to complain when something breaks. The people building pqp are there.
memberList.title: Members
thread.title: Thread
thread.archivedHint: Quiet for {days}+ days, replying wakes it back up.
thread.error.start: Couldn't start the thread. Try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.feedback.description: Bugs, ideas, anything on your mind
settings.feedback.intro: Found a bug? Tell us, a confirmed catch earns the 🐛 caça-bugs badge on your public profile. Ideas and gripes welcome too.
settings.feedback.kind.label: What is it?
settings.feedback.placeholder: What happened, and where? The more detail, the faster the hunt.
settings.feedback.done: Got it. If the bug checks out, the badge is yours. 🐛
downloadHint.label: Get the app
settings.profile.description: How you show up to everybody else.
settings.profile.banner.hint: The strip across the top of your public page. {width}×{height} works best.
settings.profile.banner.empty: No banner, your page draws its own.
settings.profile.banner.unconfigured: This server has no file storage set up, so banners cannot be uploaded here.
settings.profile.usernameHint: Becomes username#1234, discriminator auto-assigned if taken.
settings.profile.saveNote: This section applies when you save. Everything else applies the moment you change it.
settings.profile.publicHandle.hint: A page anyone can open, even without an account. Different from your username#1234, and there is only one of each.
settings.profile.publicHandle.cooldown: You can change this again on {date}.
settings.connections.intro: Prove you own the account. Nicks show on your profile card; the public page only if you say so. This is not how you sign in to pqp.
settings.connections.accessNote: pqp cannot sign in as you or change anything on those accounts. We do not keep a login token. Connecting does not show what you are playing.
settings.connections.unconfigured: This server has not set up any game connections yet.
settings.connections.visibility.label: Who can see this
settings.voice.description: Devices and levels apply when joining voice. Changes while connected update live when possible.
settings.voice.permissionNeeded: Microphone permission needed to list devices and show input level.
settings.voice.mode.activityHint: Your mic is open whenever you are not muted.
settings.voice.mode.pttHint: Your mic stays closed until you hold a key or the button.
settings.voice.pttHint: {key} works while this window is focused and you are not typing. It cannot work while another app is in front, the voice panel has a hold-to-talk button for that.
settings.voice.pttNoKeyboard: This device has no keyboard to bind, so push-to-talk uses the hold-to-talk button in the voice panel.
settings.voice.processing.echoHint: Stops others hearing themselves back through your speakers.
settings.voice.processing.noiseHint: Removes fans and keyboards, and some of your consonants.
settings.voice.processing.gainHint: Evens out your level, and raises the room between sentences.
settings.voice.processing.note: Changing these re-opens the microphone. Nobody is dropped from the call.
settings.voice.outputUnsupported: Output device selection is not supported in this browser.
settings.voice.videoQuality.hint: One choice for both your camera and your screen share, and it only governs the video leaving this device. It does not change how anyone else's camera or screen looks to you: in a call, the size you receive is the size the sender is sending, and nothing on this side can raise it. Auto asks for 720p from the camera and lets the connection decide from there. A fixed choice asks for that size instead, and sends your screen share at that size too. Your screen is still captured at 1080p whatever you pick, so moving the setting back up costs you nothing. The picture still drops below your choice when the link cannot carry it.
settings.voice.videoQuality.measuring: Camera on, measuring what is going out.
settings.voice.videoQuality.idle: Turn your camera on or share your screen during a call to see what is actually going out.
settings.notifications.description: What reaches you, and where. Per-community and per-channel settings win over these.
settings.notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show desktop notifications.
settings.notifications.denied: Blocked for this site. Allow notifications in your browser's site settings to turn them back on, the page cannot ask again.
settings.notifications.willAsk: Your browser will ask for permission.
settings.notifications.levelHint: Applies where a community or channel has no setting of its own. Right-click a community or channel to change just that one.
settings.notifications.soundsHint: In-app. Play for messages you send and receive, including in the channel you're looking at. Silent while Do Not Disturb is on.
settings.notifications.sounds.ringHint: Click a tone to hear it. Incoming calls use the one that is selected.
settings.push.title: Push · when the app is closed
settings.push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, push only works from the installed app: open pqp in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, and enable push from inside the installed app.
settings.push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
settings.push.notConfigured: Push is not configured on this server.
settings.push.on: Mentions, replies and DMs reach this device when the app is closed.
settings.push.off: Only mentions, replies and direct messages, never every message.
settings.push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's settings first.
settings.push.failed: Could not subscribe this device. Try again after a reload.
settings.push.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Your subscription was not saved.
settings.push.dmDetails: Show who sent a direct message
settings.push.dmDetailsHint: Off, a DM push says only “New direct message”. Message text is never included either way.
settings.appearance.syncHint: Changes apply now, and follow your account to other devices.
settings.appearance.accentDefaultHint: The colour that comes with the look.
settings.appearance.accentCustomHint: Your accent, on top of the look.
settings.appearance.themeNightLocked: Night stays dark. Pick another look to use light.
settings.appearance.contrastHint: Makes text and borders easier to tell apart.
settings.appearance.languageHint: The page reloads to switch language. Save your profile first if you were editing it.
settings.privacy.description: Who can reach you. Enforced on the server, not just here.
settings.privacy.dmLabel: Who can start a direct message with you
settings.privacy.dm.serverMembers: People I share a community with
settings.privacy.dmHint: Applies to new conversations. Anyone you are already talking to can still reach you, tightening this is not a way to disappear on someone mid-sentence.
settings.privacy.blockedEmpty: Nobody. Blocking someone stops their messages reaching you and hides what they say in shared channels behind a tap.
settings.data.description: Take everything with you, or close the account for good.
settings.data.exportHint: A JSON file of everything we hold about you.
settings.data.exportBody: It includes your profile, your settings, every message you wrote, the communities you are in, and who you have blocked. It does not include messages other people wrote, including their side of your direct messages. Those are their words, not your data, and you can still read them here in the app.
settings.data.deleteHint: Permanent. There is no undo and no backup to restore from.
settings.data.legalHint: How we handle your data, the terms of the hosted service, and what we store on this device.
settings.delete.title: Delete your account
settings.delete.lead: This cannot be undone. We keep no backup you can be restored from, and nobody at pqp can bring your account back.
settings.delete.goes.profile: Your profile, handle, avatar and settings.
settings.delete.goes.messages: Every message you have written, everywhere, including in direct messages. Other people will see gaps where your messages were.
settings.delete.goes.files: Your files and images, and the reactions you left.
settings.delete.goes.memberships: Your memberships, your conversations, and the list of people you blocked.
settings.delete.goes.signIn: Your sign-in. You will not be able to log back in.
settings.delete.goes.servers: Any community you own on your own, with nobody else in it.
settings.delete.stays.moderation: Moderation records of actions you took in other people's communities, with your name removed. Deleting an account must not erase the record of how it was used to moderate somebody else.
settings.delete.stays.bans: Bans you issued. Removing them would let everybody you banned back into communities you no longer have anything to do with.
settings.delete.stays.reports: Reports other people filed about you, with your name removed. We are not able to let an account be deleted as a way of clearing its own record.
settings.delete.staysNote: All of these are pruned on their own schedule. The privacy policy explains them in full.
settings.delete.ownedTitle: Do one of these first, for each community you own
settings.delete.ownedBody: Other people are still in these communities, so we will not delete them out from under them. In each community's settings, either hand it to another member or delete the community yourself.
serverSettings.nav.label: Community settings sections
serverSettings.overview.description: What this community is called and what it looks like.
serverSettings.access.description: Who can walk in, and how they find their way here.
serverSettings.roles.description: Who can do what in this community, and which names show up when someone types @.
serverSettings.integrations.description: Ping an HTTPS URL when someone posts. Incoming webhooks stay on the channel row.
serverSettings.moderation.description: Reports from members, and how long messages are kept.
serverSettings.audit.description: Every moderator action taken in this server, newest first.
serverSettings.danger.description: Take the data with you, hand the server on, or end it.
serverSettings.readOnly.admin: Only the server owner can rename this server, change its pictures, transfer ownership, or delete it.
serverSettings.readOnly.member: Only owners and admins can change server settings. Ask one if something here needs to change.
serverSettings.name.title: Community name
serverSettings.name.label: Community name
serverSettings.identity.title: Icon & banner
serverSettings.identity.description: The icon is what this server looks like in the sidebar. The banner runs across the top of the channel list, with the name over it. Both are optional, without them the server draws its first two letters, which is how it looks today.
serverSettings.identity.iconHint: A rounded square, same as the rail. Cropped from the middle to {size}×{size}.
serverSettings.identity.bannerHint: The strip above the channels. Cropped from the middle to {width}×{height}.
serverSettings.identity.unconfigured: This deployment has no file storage configured, so pictures cannot be uploaded. The server keeps its monogram.
serverSettings.sso.title: SSO email domain
serverSettings.sso.description: Anyone with a verified email at this domain can join {server} without an invite. Only verified addresses count, and existing bans still apply. Leave empty to turn this off.
serverSettings.sso.label: SSO email domain
serverSettings.sso.failed: Failed to update the SSO domain
serverSettings.retention.title: Message retention
serverSettings.retention.description: Automatically delete messages older than this, across every channel in {server}. Pinned messages are never touched.
serverSettings.retention.label: Message retention
serverSettings.audit.title: Audit log
serverSettings.audit.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Kicks, bans, role changes, and channel or server edits will show up here.
serverSettings.audit.failed: Failed to load the audit log
serverSettings.export.title: Export data
serverSettings.export.description: Download every channel, member, and message in {server} as a JSON file. Attachment bytes are not included, only their filenames and sizes.
serverSettings.transfer.title: Transfer ownership
serverSettings.transfer.description: The new owner gets full control of {server}. You become an admin and cannot take ownership back yourself.
serverSettings.transfer.nobody: There is nobody else in this server to hand it to.
serverSettings.transfer.label: New owner
serverSettings.delete.title: Delete community
serverSettings.delete.description: Every channel, message, and invite in {server} is deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.
sso.body_single: Your verified email lets you join this community without an invite.
sso.body_several: Your verified email lets you join these communities without an invite.

voice.error.cameraBlocked_desktop: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your system settings and try again.

settings.push.unsupported_desktop: This app cannot receive push notifications.
settings.push.denied_desktop: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your system settings first.

chat.reaction.ariaMine: {emoji} reaction, {people}, you reacted, activate to remove
communityHome.title: Baú
communityHome.subtitle: Posts from {name} that stay put
communityHome.intro.title: This is the Baú of {name}
communityHome.intro.lead: The chest where the staff keeps what should not scroll away. Chat is for now; the Baú is for later.
communityHome.intro.posts.title: Posts, not messages
communityHome.intro.posts.body: Clips, images, files and YouTube links, newest first. Only the staff posts here.
communityHome.intro.react.title: Like what you like
communityHome.intro.react.body: One tap on the heart. That is how the staff learns what to post more of.
communityHome.intro.comments.title: Comments are a list, not a chat
communityHome.intro.comments.body: The two newest show under each post. Open the rest when you want them.
communityHome.intro.vip.title: Some posts are VIP
communityHome.intro.vip.body: A locked post shows its title and a teaser. The rest is for members with the VIP cargo.
communityHome.empty.member: Nothing in the Baú yet. When the staff of {name} posts, it shows up here.
communityHome.vipMemberNote: You have the VIP cargo, so you see every post in full.
communityHome.notice.pinned: Pinned. It stays at the top of the Baú.
communityHome.settings.title: Baú
communityHome.settings.helper: A feed of posts that stay: clips, images, files, and the weekly recap. Staff post; members like and comment. Off by default.
communityHome.settings.failed: Could not update the Baú setting for this server.
communityHome.guide.emptyTitle: Your Baú is empty. Let's change that.
communityHome.guide.emptyLead: The Baú is your community's own place for content: clips, guides, files and posts that stay put. People like and comment, you see what lands, and the best of it can be for members only.
communityHome.guide.clip.title: Share the moment
communityHome.guide.clip.body: The clip from last session, a screenshot, a YouTube link. Anything worth watching twice.
communityHome.guide.file.title: Keep the essentials in one place
communityHome.guide.file.body: Rules, maps, character sheets, the PDF everybody asks for. Pinned for good, found in one click.
communityHome.guide.react.title: Hear back from your people
communityHome.guide.react.body: Likes and comments on every post, without the feed turning into chat.
communityHome.guide.vip.title: Exclusive content, coming soon
communityHome.guide.vip.body: Lock a post for VIP members and leave a teaser for everyone else.
communityHome.guide.schedule.title: The weekly recap, on schedule
communityHome.guide.schedule.body: Write it when you have time, pick a date, and it goes up on its own.
communityHome.guide.notAvisos: Write now, schedule for later. Nothing here pings anyone: people open the Baú when they want to.
communityHome.guide.demoLabel: A Baú with a week in it
communityHome.lockedBody: The full post is for members with the VIP cargo.
communityHome.comments.off: Comments are off on this post.
communityHome.compose.title: New post
communityHome.compose.fileHint: Image, short video or PDF, up to {limit}
communityHome.compose.noStorage: File uploads are off on this server. YouTube links still work.
communityHome.compose.needsTitleAndConte: A post needs a title and some text or media.
communityHome.compose.videoOverLimit: That video is over the limit. Upload it to YouTube and paste the link instead.
communityHome.compose.uploadFailed: The upload did not go through. Try again.
communityHome.compose.badYoutube: That is not a YouTube watch, youtu.be or shorts link.
communityHome.compose.scheduleInPast: Pick a time in the future.
communityHome.drafts.unscheduleHint: Back to a draft; nothing goes up.
communityHome.notice.published: Published. It is in the Baú now.
communityHome.notice.scheduled: Scheduled. It goes up on its own.

communityHome.inspector.title: View as
communityHome.error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
chrome.pinConversationFull: The rail is full ({count}). Unpin one to add another.
chrome.serverUnavailable: That community is gone, or you are not in it.
chrome.deleteChannelConfirm: Delete this channel? Messages cannot be recovered.
composer.slowMode: Slow mode. You can send again in {seconds}s.

composer.confirmHere: This will notify everyone currently online in this channel. Send it?
composer.confirmEveryoneHere: This will notify everyone who can see this channel, including people who are online. Send it?
chat.empty.title: Start the thread
chat.empty.body: Messages persist. Use **bold**, *italic*, `code`, and links. Shift+Enter adds a line.
chat.forward.title: Forward message
chat.forward.description: Pick a channel or conversation. The quote lands in the composer so you can send it.
chat.reject.noAccess: You can't send in this channel
chat.reject.cannotSend: You don't have permission to send here
pins.description: Messages the channel has agreed are worth finding again.
pins.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Right-click a message to pin it.
search.title: Search messages
search.wholeWords: Different words find different things, search matches whole words, not fragments.
reports.empty.open: Nothing to review. Reports members file about messages or people in this server show up here.
reports.empty.all: No reports have been filed in this server.
reports.messageDeleted: The message has since been deleted. The copy above was taken when the report was filed.
report.body.message: Moderators will see a copy of this message, who sent it, and anything you add below.
report.body.user: Moderators will see who you reported and anything you add below. No messages are attached.
report.sendFailed: Could not send this report. Try again in a moment.
report.placeholder: Context, links, or what happened before this.
report.blockHint: If this person is bothering you directly, blocking them stops them reaching you while the report is looked at.
channelMeta.title: Channel settings
channelMeta.description: Topic shows under the channel name. Icon can be an emoji or an image URL.
channelMeta.iconHint: An emoji, or an https image link.
channelMeta.slowMode.hint: Members send once per interval. Manage Messages skips it.
channelMembers.description: Listed members get an extra View Channel allow. Owners still see the channel. Use Permissions to deny send or hide the channel from a role.
timeout.title: Time out {name}?
timeout.body: {name} stays in {server} and can still read every channel. They cannot post, react or join voice until the timeout ends. It does not touch their direct messages.
timeout.mesh: This call runs peer-to-peer, the audio never touches the server, so a server mute cannot be enforced. Disconnect them or use a timeout instead.
timeout.sfuMute: {name}'s mic is muted at the voice server. They can unmute themselves, for anything lasting, use a timeout.
member.nicknamePrompt: Nickname in this community (leave blank to clear)
roles.name: Role name
roles.everyoneHint: @everyone is the base role. Every member has it, and it cannot be deleted.
roles.everyoneLockedHint: Not allowed on @everyone. Put this on a higher role.
roles.hierarchyHint: Higher outranks. Kick, ban, and timeout only work on people below.
roles.adminHint: Admin carries Administrator. It cannot be deleted.
roles.ownerHint: Owner is you, because you created this community. Colour, a member-list section, and the crown. It is not assigned; transfer ownership to move it.
roles.managerHint: Manager has every staff tool except Administrator. Channel overwrites still apply.
roles.moderatorHint: Moderator can time out, kick, mute in voice, delete messages, and change nicknames. No ban, and no role or channel management.
roles.vipHint: VIP is a colour and a member-list section. No extra powers. Tick it on people you want easy to find.
roles.showBadge: Show the crown next to the name
roles.permHint.ADMINISTRATOR: Grants every other permission and ignores channel overwrites, including private channels.
roles.permHint.CREATE_INVITE: Create invite links so new people can join.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_CHANNELS: Create, rename, and delete channels, including private ones.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_SERVER: Change this community's name, picture, and listing.
roles.permHint.VIEW_CHANNEL: See channels. Without this, the rest of the channel permissions do nothing.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_MESSAGES: Delete other people's messages, and pin any message.
roles.permHint.READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY: See older messages, not only the ones posted after you arrived.
roles.permHint.MENTION_EVERYONE: Use @everyone and @here, and mention any role.
roles.permHint.MUTE_MEMBERS: Mute someone in voice so they cannot be heard.
roles.permHint.CHANGE_NICKNAME: Change your nickname in this community. Mentions still use your username.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_NICKNAMES: Change other members' nicknames, if your role ranks above theirs.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_ROLES: Create and edit roles below yours. You can only turn on permissions you already have.
roles.permHint.MODERATE_MEMBERS: Silence someone for a while, or pull them out of a voice channel.
roles.mentionable: Allow anyone to mention this role
roles.hoist: Show separately in the member list
roles.hoistHint: People with this role get their own section while they are online. Highest role wins.
roles.permHint.MANAGE_WEBHOOKS: Create and edit outgoing webhooks that POST new messages to an HTTPS URL.
notify.menu.heading: Notifications
slash.shrug.description: Append a shrug to your message
slash.nick.tooLong: Display name must be 100 characters or fewer.
slash.invite.description: Open the invite panel for this server
slash.join.description: Join a server with an invite code
slash.gif.unconfigured: GIF search isn’t configured on this server. Paste a GIF link instead.
slash.clear.ok: Composer cleared. Server message history is not deleted (no API for that).
slash.unknown: Unknown command. Type /help for a list.
webhooks.description: Anything that can POST JSON to a URL can post here, paste the address into a CI job, GitHub, or a monitoring tool exactly the way you would a Discord webhook URL.
webhooks.copyBlocked: Could not copy, clipboard access was blocked.
integrations.lead: When someone posts in a channel you pick, pqp sends a signed POST. Chat does not wait.
integrations.incomingHint: Bots that post into a channel use Incoming webhooks on that channel's row.
integrations.emptyHint: Add an endpoint, pick the channels, copy the signing secret once.
integrations.authKept: Current header ends in {hint}. Leave the value blank to keep it.
integrations.urlHint: HTTPS in production. HTTP is allowed only on a local server. No passwords in the URL.
integrations.channelsEmpty: This community has no text channels yet.
integrations.authHint: Grok Bot wants Authorization and Bearer plus its sender key. pqp still signs the body with its own HMAC secret.
integrations.copyBlocked: Could not copy. Clipboard access was blocked.
integrations.secretOnce: Copy this now. pqp will not show it again.
integrations.skipHint: Their messages will not fire this hook. Use this for a helper that is a normal account, like Caio.
timeout.reasonPlaceholder: Optional, but this is what you will read next week
slash.unknownNamed: Unknown command /{name}. Type /help for a list.
slash.roll.description: Roll a 20-sided die, or pick another
slash.roll.invalid: That is not dice notation. Try /roll, /roll 2d6+3, or /roll 2d6+1d8.
slash.roll.badFace: Only d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, and d100.
slash.poll.description: Start a poll in this channel
slash.poll.needOptions: A poll needs a question and at least two options. Use /poll or the poll button.
poll.selectMultiple: Pick as many as you like
poll.composer.title: Create a poll
poll.composer.question: Question
search.minChars: Type at least {count} characters. Results cover every channel you can see.
report.thanks: Thanks, moderators have been notified. You will not be told who reviews it.
dm.title: Messages
dm.dialog.title: Start a conversation
dm.dialog.description: Find someone by handle. Add more than one to make it a group.
dm.dialog.full: That is the most people one conversation holds. A bigger group wants a server, which has moderation.
userSearch.heading: People
userSearch.nobody: Nobody matched. Handles are exact, try name#0000.
chat.webhookPosted: Posted by a webhook, not a member
gif.unavailable: GIF search is unavailable right now.
member.moveBody: {name} will be disconnected and their app will rejoin the channel you pick. They can only be moved to a voice channel they already have access to.
member.banBody: {name} will be removed from {server} and cannot rejoin by invite until the ban is lifted.
member.removeBody: {name} will be removed from {server}. They can rejoin with a new invite.
member.liftBanHint: Lift the ban from the Banned section to let them back in.
member.emptyInvite: Nobody here yet. Invite people to get started.
member.disconnectFailed: Failed to disconnect them from voice
member.bansEmpty: Nobody is banned from this server.
channelMembers.everyoneHasAccess: Everyone on the server already has access.
channelPerms.title: Permissions
channelPerms.description: Allow, inherit, or deny each permission for a role or member. Inherit uses the server role. Administrator ignores these overwrites.
channelPerms.everyoneViewLocked: Use the channel's private setting to control who sees it.
update.ready: A new version of pqp is ready.
update.dismiss.label: Dismiss update notice
whatsNew.feed.title: What's new
whatsNew.feed.lede: What shipped, on the day it shipped.
whatsNew.feed.origin: Whoever ships it writes the note. Same text here and on the site.
